warmup: Dr. Nair here. Kai and Mo tested the same bottle cap and got opposite results! Read both notes. Tap every place where they tested differently. Then decide: whose result should we trust?
part1: Predict first. Will it stick? Then turn the dial: how sure are you? Press Test it. If you were sure and wrong, you earn a gold star. That is big learning!
part2: Mo used sticky notes, and they are a mess! Read each note, then drag it onto the right row of the data table. Watch the spoon row. A surprise is hiding there.
explore: First, lock the fair test settings. Then pick an item and slide it toward the magnet along the ruler. Does it jump? At how many centimeters? Your data table fills in as you go.
